hotspots.title: Potion Vials
hotspots.text: Glass vials filled with prepared remedies: antitoxins, stimulants, and numbing agents. Each color-coded by effect.

hotspots.title: Herbalist's Satchel
hotspots.text: A reinforced leather pouch containing mortar, pestle, and dried ingredients. The buckles are worn smooth from years of use.

hotspots.title: Hooded Cape
hotspots.text: A weathered traveler's cloak. The mottled brown fabric helps her blend into crowds when she'd rather not be noticed.

hotspots.title: Hair Buns
hotspots.text: Practical space buns keep her hair out of the way during delicate work. The ties are thin golden cord, subtle but sturdy.

hotspots.title: Work Apron
hotspots.text: A faded rose-colored apron, stained with tinctures and herb residue. The fabric is worn thin at the edges from countless washings.

hotspots.title: Constellation Mark
hotspots.text: A cluster of pale scars just above her wrist. It looks like an old chemical burn, but the pattern seems oddly deliberate.

hotspots.title: Boots
hotspots.text: Sturdy leather boots with reinforced soles. Made for standing long hours at a workbench, but practical enough for the docks.
